about_the_game:
A Halloween party. A haunted castle. A game that went too far.

Halloween Secrets: The Blood Vow Collector's Edition is a chilling hidden-object puzzle adventure where urban legend becomes terrifying reality. When three friends sneak into the abandoned сastle for a night of dares and ghost stories, they think it’s all harmless fun—until one of them vanishes into thin air. 

Reveal the castle’s cursed history, battle illusions and the undead, and search for magical relics tied to three witches. Every clue draws you deeper into the web!

Can you save your friend and escape the grip of ancient evil? Or has the nightmare only just begun?

🔹 Explore cursed locations packed with hidden objects and secrets.

🔹 Solve clever puzzles and mini-games woven into the dark narrative.

🔹 Track down collectibles, artifacts, and fragments of the castle’s twisted past.

🔹 Explore multiple layers of cursed history through artifacts and dialogue.

🔹 Enjoy exclusive content and story extras.

Not every nightmare ends at dawn...
